headlines.title: Suspect in Berlin Pride march attack shot and killed by police
headlines.description: Berlin police shot and killed the suspect in the deadly attack in the city’s Pride festival after he allegedly charged at officers with a knife while they tried to arrest him, authorities said.

headlines.title: Kornacki: Which states Democrats ‘have to win’ for control of Congress
headlines.description: NBC News Chief Data Analyst Steve Kornacki joins Meet the Press to analyze the key issues weighing on Republicans and Democrats 100 days out from the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Amb. Mike Waltz says military has ‘everything that it needs’ amid supply concerns: Full interview
headlines.description: U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz tells Meet the Press that the Trump administration “inherited” a depleted supply of munitions after an NBC News report revealed that military commanders have been selectively intercepting Iranian attacks to preserve diminishing weapons supplies.

headlines.title: Europe Wildfires Forces More Than 250,000 People to Evacuate
headlines.description: A growing wildfire emergency is unfolding across Europe forcing a quarter of a million people to flee as firefighters battle massive blazes in France and Spain. Meanwhile, 90 million people in the U.S are under heat alerts from California to Florida. NBC’s Priscilla Thompson reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Influencer killed by husband after she accused him of pedophilia on TikTok
headlines.description: Social media influencer Sara Gilson was killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records.

headlines.title: Ryan Coogler announces David Jonsson as the new Black Panther
headlines.description: There’s a new Black Panther, and his name is David Jonsson.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: First Kenyan-born NFL player deported, ICE says
headlines.description: A former Indianapolis Colts linebacker from Kenya was deported by ICE last month, the agency said in a statement Saturday, citing an overstayed visa and a history of arrests.

headlines.title: U.S. forgoes strikes on Iran, but conflict escalates in the Red Sea
headlines.description: The Iran war ​broadened over the weekend despite a pause in U.S. strikes, as Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis attacked Saudi oil installations along the Red Sea coast and Iran ‌accused Ukraine of targeting one of its vessels in the Caspian Sea.

headlines.title: Mike Waltz dismisses concerns over depleted U.S. weapons stockpile amid Iran war
headlines.description: Mike Waltz, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, said in an interview on NBC’s “Meet the Press” that the U.S. has “everything that it needs” for military operations against Iran dismissing reports that the U.S. has depleted weapons stockpiles.

headlines.title: Berlin police kill suspect in Pride festival attack after manhunt
headlines.description: Berlin police shot and killed the suspect in this weekend’s deadly attack in the city’s Pride festival after he allegedly charged at officers with a knife while they tried to arrest him Sunday, authorities said.
